title: Canadian Coastal Sailing

services.name: Boat Tour
services.desc: Squamish is the wind-sport capital of Canada and one of the premiere locations in the world to sail. Canadian Coastal Sailing offers a selection of professionally crewed boat tours departing from downtown Squamish designed for individuals, private groups or special occasions. Whether planning a romantic occasion or escaping outdoors with your social bubble, the magic of sailing through the mountainous fjord of northern Howe Sound will be a cherished memory for years to come. Enjoy the exclusive use of our crewed vessel and the flexibility of an experience customized for you and your group.
